title: Mobility Equipment Pickup Lead Time and Equipment Recovery Charges Schedule
content:
# Recovery Charges Schedule — Mobility Equipment

For a rented Mobility Equipment chair the schedule gives the pickup lead time, the days after which a chair not recovered is charged, and the two recovery charges, in US dollars.

- **Pickup lead** — business days after a confirmed return within which the chair is picked up.
- **Unreturned period** — calendar days after the confirmed pickup date after which a rented chair still not recovered is charged.
- **Unreturned equipment charge** — the charge for a rented chair not recovered.
- **Damage fee** — the charge for a rented chair recovered damaged beyond normal wear.

| Class | Pickup lead (business days) | Unreturned period (calendar days) | Unreturned equipment charge (USD) | Damage fee beyond normal wear (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Manual Wheelchair (K0001) | 5 | 30 | 350.00 | 75.00 |
| Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) | 5 | 30 | 495.00 | 75.00 |
| High-Strength Lightweight Wheelchair (K0004) | 5 | 30 | 690.00 | 100.00 |
| Ultralightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0005) | 5 | 30 | 1950.00 | 250.00 |
| Group 2 Standard Power Wheelchair (K0823) | 5 | 30 | 3200.00 | 400.00 |
| Group 3 Complex Rehab Power Wheelchair (K0856) | 5 | 30 | 7150.00 | 650.00 |

## Reading the schedule

- The pickup lead (5 business days) and the unreturned period (30 calendar days) are the same for every class; the two charges rise with the class.
- **Hypothetical comparison.** A Lightweight Manual Wheelchair (K0003) recovered damaged beyond normal wear carries a 75.00 damage fee; the same class not recovered at all carries a 495.00 unreturned equipment charge.
